title: SMTP ingestion pipeline: receive-only MTA with Sieve delivery
description: Add a receive-only SMTP daemon that accepts inbound email on ports 25 and 587, verifies sender authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC/ARC), routes mailing list messages (keyed by List-ID header) into newsgroup articles via the existing article write path, and filters all other mail through per-user Sieve scripts into a hierarchical JMAP mailbox tree (dot-separated names, e.g. INBOX.Work.ProjectFoo). No outbound SMTP. No relay. No vacation/redirect.
